description: Figure 6b illustrates the relationship between hyperparameter N and the Area Under the Curve (AUC) score. The x-axis is labeled “N”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)”, has a linear scale, ranges from 60 to 100, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. There are four lines displayed on the plot. The first line is yellow and solid, starting at approximately 63% at N=0 and ending at approximately 98% at N=20. The second line is purple and dashed, starting at approximately 72% at N=0 and ending at approximately 96% at N=20. The third line is orange and dotted, starting at approximately 78% at N=0 and ending at approximately 94% at N=20. The fourth line is red and has a star marker, starting at approximately 82% at N=0 and ending at approximately 92% at N=20.
